title: A profile of siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei; while at OpenAI, Dario suggested immersive videogames might ease political strife from AI-induced joblessness (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: A profile of siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei; while at OpenAI, Dario suggested immersive videogames might ease political strife from AI-induced joblessness — Dario and Daniela Amodei were on top of the biggest IPO ever Thursday-and a market rout one day later.
